ARCS kitMolecule 51display-preferences

Display Preferences

Give every reader the theme switch and the reading options (easy-read font, larger text, roomy spacing) side by side in the header, remembered on their device.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1Theme switchPill button: icon, the label Dark mode, a track; aria-pressed says if dark is on; 48px tallsurface, border, on cyan
2Aa button48px circle beside it, aria-expanded, opens the panel below itselfsurface, border, hover cyan
3PanelNon-modal dialog placed under the Aa button, right edges aligned; groups of pressed buttonssurface, border, ds-r-md
4Reading attributesdata-font=easy swaps --ds-font-sans and --ds-font-display; data-size l/xl sets the root font to 112.5%/125%; data-space=roomy adds letter, word and line spacingds-font-sans, ds-font-display
5PhoneAt 520px and below the switch's text label is hidden; aria-label keeps the name; the icon and track staynone

Usage

Use it when

  • Any client page whose readers include people who rely on a dyslexia-friendly font, larger text or wider spacing.
  • Every other block on the page must use rem or em and the kit font tokens, so these settings reach it.
  • Run the reading-options check on every page change: largest size, roomy spacing and easy-read font, at 375 and 1280.

Do not use it when

  • Do not float the Aa button at the bottom of the page; it lives in the header next to the theme switch.
  • Do not use it on a video frame or fixed render. Pages with only a theme need just 39 Theme toggle.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
keystringyeslocalStorage key for the saved settings object, such as myAllyRead; read in a pre-paint head script, every access in try/catch.
groups[]{k, label, options[]}noDefaults: font std/easy, size std/l/xl, space std/roomy.

Access

  • The theme switch is a <button> named Dark mode with aria-pressed; its aria-label keeps the name on phones, where the text label is hidden.
  • The Aa button has aria-label=Reading options, aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is role=dialog with aria-modal=false, labelled by its title.
  • Opening moves focus to the pressed option; Escape or Close closes and returns focus to Aa.
  • Options are groups of aria-pressed buttons, each 44px tall, with a visible label per group.
